blocks: Saved export: September 28, 2026 MIDI Control Center user-bank archive, computer-bank slot 160, file 160-09282026 6h14-A160.mbp. The computer-bank slot differs from this page’s observed device slot.
The parameter payload matches Factory 1.1, 2.1, 3.0 and 6.0. This is an archived factory-equivalent baseline; it does not establish the instrument’s saved or unsaved state during a later session.
Model: SuperWave. Wave chooses saw, square, triangle or sine; Timbre changes detuning; Shape changes the volume of the detuned copies.
Low-pass filter. Saved cutoff: 0.187; resonance: 0.415. Cutoff and resonance are normalized settings, not hertz or instrument display values.
Main envelope: attack 0.000, decay/release 0.300, sustain 0.000. Amp Mod is on, so the main envelope controls loudness.
Cycling Envelope mode: Run. Stored RiseLvl 0.055, FallLvl 0.057, Hold 0.000, Amount 1.000. These are normalized stored fields; rise/fall times in milliseconds remain unverified.
Triangle; clock sync on. Stored normalized rate: 0.148; division code: 1. The rate is not a hertz reading, and the musical division has not been converted.
Amounts use the signed normalized range −1…+1. The assignment destinations below resolve the saved Assign columns.
PRESSURE → Wave: −1.000. Expression moves the SuperWave waveform selection.
ENV → Timbre / Detune: −0.430. The main envelope reduces detuning.
ENV → Cutoff: +0.471. The main envelope opens the filter.
PRESSURE → Assign 1 → Decay/Release: +0.561. Expression lengthens the main envelope decay/release.
All other saved matrix amounts are zero.

The saved main envelope has an immediate attack and no sustained level. Expression changes both waveform selection and decay/release. The Cycling Envelope, LFO and Key/Arp rows have no nonzero matrix routes in this export.

Paraphonic mode is on in the saved export. The PRESSURE matrix row uses pressure or velocity according to the instrument’s global Utility setting; the export does not establish which expression source was used in the session.

Base controls use normalized 0…1 values unless a stored choice code is shown; matrix amounts use −1…+1. These describe saved base settings, before modulation, and are not OLED percentages, hertz or milliseconds.
The saved-parameter inspector preserves the original fields. Oscillator interpretation assumes the documented firmware 5 layout; firmware is not detected from the export.
Matrix columns and assignments follow the Freakout live map and assignment decoder. Mode and waveform labels follow the MicroFreak Reader definitions.
Microfreak/UG/05 Connections/02 Matrix and Encoder/01 Sources and Destinations explains matrix sources, destinations and the expression row.
Saved export: read from the device's slot 93 over USB on October 25, 2026 with mise run microfreak:download --slot 93. Two consecutive reads returned the same file.

The parameter payload matches the MIDI Control Center archives Factory 1.0, Factory 1.1, Factory 2.1, Factory 3.0, Factory 6.0 (Factory 1.0 slot 180, Factory 1.1 slot 180, Factory 2.1 slot 175, Factory 3.0 slot 175, Factory 6.0 slot 416). Comparison used mise run microfreak:compare.
Download the slot 93 capture. It is the raw device format (header plus data packets), not an .mbp file; see Microfreak/Preset/093 Blind/Asset/Device-Read-2026-10-25/bin.
Model: Speech. Microfreak/UG/06 Dig Osc/03 Types/11 Speech
High-pass filter. Saved cutoff: 0.701; resonance: 0.636. Microfreak/UG/07 Filter/01 Modifying Sound/03 High Pass Filter
Main envelope: attack 0.000, decay/release 0.869, sustain 0.000. Amp Mod is on, so the main envelope controls loudness. Microfreak/UG/09 Envelope Gen/03 Envelope Stages
Cycling Envelope mode: Run. Stored RiseLvl 0.163, RiseSlp 0.500, FallLvl 0.152, FallSlp 0.500, Hold 0.000, Amount 0.101. Microfreak/UG/09 Envelope Gen/06 Cycling Envelope
Triangle, clock sync on; stored division code: 0. Microfreak/UG/08 LFO/01 LFO Shape · Microfreak/UG/08 LFO/02 LFO Rate
Amounts use the signed normalized range −1…+1. Microfreak/UG/05 Connections/02 Matrix and Encoder/01 Sources and Destinations
All other saved matrix amounts are zero.

Play different keys to change both pitch and the Speech Word selection: KEY/ARP has a full positive route to Word, with an additional triangle-LFO route moving it. The immediate attack, zero sustain and long decay give each note a decaying spoken gesture. Microfreak/UG/06 Dig Osc/03 Types/11 Speech

Expression raises Cycling Envelope Amount and shortens its Rise setting, strengthening the saved cycling-envelope pitch motion and bringing its rise forward. The PRESSURE row follows the global pressure-or-velocity setting; that choice is not captured in the preset. Microfreak/UG/05 Connections/02 Matrix and Encoder/01 Sources and Destinations
The October 25 factory-equivalent capture describes the starting sound. A later recording or MIDI capture is needed to identify the words played, knob edits and expression used during a session.
Values describe saved base settings before modulation. Controls use normalized 0…1 values unless a stored choice code is shown; they are not OLED percentages, hertz or milliseconds.
The saved-parameter inspector preserves the original fields. Oscillator interpretation assumes the documented firmware 5 layout; firmware is not detected from the export.
Matrix assignments follow the Freakout live map. Mode, LFO shape, filter type and octave labels follow the MicroFreak Reader definitions.
